description: University Grant Commission - Appointed Senior Prof. R. M. U. S. K. Rathnayaka to be the Competent Authority with effect from 25.11.2024 of the University of Ruhuna.
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Harini Amarasuriya) in her official capacity as Minister and outlines detailed responsibilities and powers being exercised under the Universities Act. It contains both the "who" (a named government minister) and the "what" (specific powers and functions being assigned/delegated, including the appointment of a Competent Authority with defined responsibilities). This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it combines personnel information with detailed portfolio responsibilities.
